🇲🇽🚡 <u>CDMX IS BUILDING THE WORLD'S LONGEST CABLE CAR LINE</u>

Mexico City is adding three Cablebús lines to connect the peripheries the old city never reached. Line 5 — Álvaro Obregón to La Magdalena Contreras, nearly 16 km — will be the longest urban cable car line on the planet, in a system that already moves 50 million passengers a year. Lines 4 and 6 open in late 2027, Line 5 in mid-2028 — and stations in indigenous pueblos like Milpa Alta only after community consultation: "There is no interest in imposing anything on the population," Brugada said.
banner: CDMX: WORLD'S LONGEST CABLE CAR LINE

text:
🇲🇽🗳️ <u>MORENA OPENS ITS 2027 INTERNAL RACE — THE LAST ONE WITH REELECTION</u>

Morena deputies can seek the party's district coordinator posts — and reelection in 2027 — without leaving their seats, party president Ariadna Montiel confirmed: "We allow what the law allows." The context matters: Sheinbaum's reform ending consecutive reelection kicks in with 2030, so 2027 is the last race under the old rules. After that, one term and back to the people.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>"THEY HIT YOU SO YOU WILL PAY THEM" — SHEINBAUM ON MEXICO'S CORPORATE MEDIA</u>

Government advertising is down to a third of what Peña Nieto showered on the big networks, and Mexico's corporate media have found their new business model: "te pego para que me pagues" — I hit you so you will pay me. Her answer: "They are looking for resources they will not get, because the money belongs to the people." López Portillo said he would not pay to be attacked. This government simply does not pay.
banner: MEDIA EXTORTION: 'HIT YOU SO YOU PAY'

text:
🇲🇽⚽ <u>MEXICO DELIVERED ITS WORLD CUP — US HOST CITIES ARE STILL WAITING ON FIFA</u>

The tournament is over and the contrast could not be clearer: Mexico closed its World Cup with a 65-billion-peso economic spill and 7.8 million visitors, while the 11 US host cities are now publicly demanding the millions FIFA promised them for social projects, The Athletic reports. FIFA packed the money and left. Mexico counted the results.
banner: WORLD CUP: MX CASHED IN, US CITIES STIFFED

text:
🚨🇲🇽 <u>MEXICO TO WASHINGTON: SEIZED CARTEL BILLIONS BELONG TO MEXICO</u>

President Sheinbaum laid it out: if the US seizes cartel assets — like the $15 billion it's pursuing from Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada — Mexico will formally request they be handed over to the country where the damage was done. And that figure isn't even money on the table: "It's a Department of Justice estimate of the damage El Mayo Zambada may have caused" over his entire criminal career, she clarified. Meanwhile Mexico's Financial Intelligence Unit is set to announce the recovery of $500,000 from Genaro García Luna — the convicted former security czar who ran the "war on drugs" for Washington's favorite president.
banner: MEXICO: WE WANT THE SEIZED CARTEL BILLIONS

text:
🇲🇽📈 <u>US TRADE DEFICIT WITH MEXICO HIT $20.3 BILLION IN JUNE — BIGGER THAN CHINA'S</u>

Trump's tariffs were supposed to shrink the deficit with Mexico. Instead, the US trade gap with Mexico reached $20.3 billion in June — larger than China's $15.3 billion, according to US Census and BEA data reported by El Financiero. Tariffs or no tariffs, the US economy runs on Mexican exports. That is the leverage Mexico brings to the T-MEC table.
banner: US DEFICIT WITH MEXICO TOPS CHINA'S

text:
🇲🇽🌽 <u>SHEINBAUM BACKS CORN PRODUCERS AS PRICES FALL: 4.57 BILLION PESOS IN SINALOA ALONE</u>

With corn prices down, the government sealed an agreement with 100,000 producers — in Sinaloa, almost 4.57 billion pesos are already being distributed to 26,800 growers. "When the price is very low, the government supports the producer," Sheinbaum said. Food sovereignty is not a slogan, it's a budget line.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>PROFESSORS AT ROSARIO CASTELLANOS UNIVERSITY DENOUNCE UNION-BUSTING</u>

Samantha Fouilloux, secretary general of the new education workers' union at Mexico City's UNRC, says she was fired after refusing to hand the union's leadership to management — a union built, she says, "with the best intention of contributing to the presidential project." Rector Alma Herrera denies any harassment and claims the group has no official registration. The university created to take in the students UNAM rejected now has a labor fight of its own.

🇲🇽🔍 <u>SHEINBAUM SIGNS DECREE: EVERY GOVERNMENT CONTRACT GOES PUBLIC MONTHLY</u>

The federal government signed a decree forcing all agencies to publish more information than the law requires — public contracts will now be disclosed every month instead of every quarter, with Pemex and CFE included. "Today we signed the guidelines to guarantee this transparency," Sheinbaum said. Next step: writing it into the General Transparency Law.

💰🇲🇽 <u>SHEINBAUM MOVES TO CAP EVERY PUBLIC PENSION AT THE PRESIDENT'S SALARY</u>

Ending the plush pensions of ex-officials has already saved nearly 5 billion pesos — some were collecting up to a million pesos a month. Now Sheinbaum will send a reform to lock the cap into law: no public pension above the president's paycheck. Republican austerity that starts at the top, not the bottom.
